name: Typography
description: One closed type scale — Heading for titles, Text for everything else, Eyebrow for kickers.

Heading.description: Section or page title. Choose level by structure, not by size.

render.description: Change the element (defaults to the matching h1–h4).

Text.description: Body, labels and values — the prop-rich one. Defaults to <span>.

size.description: Default sm — the app's baseline body size.

numeric.description: Tabular monospaced numerics — prices, amounts, aligned figures.

render.description:
Change the element, e.g. `render={

}` for a paragraph.

Eyebrow.description: Small uppercase muted label above a section (kicker). No variants.

forbidden: Do not set font size/weight/color via className; use size / weight / tone or a token.

Do not use a raw

–

or styled

for headings/body; use Heading / Text so the scale stays closed.
Do not use Heading for a small label — use Eyebrow.
Do not skip heading levels for styling; pick level by meaning, restyle via the scale.
example:
<Heading level={1}>Components</Heading>
<Eyebrow>Foundations</Eyebrow>
<Text tone="muted">Updated just now</Text>
<Text numeric weight="semibold">1,024</Text>

responsive.note: Interactive targets should remain at least 44px. Layouts should fit parent width without horizontal overflow on mobile.
